# Rejected Field Archive proof: 2e8e544

The maintainer rejected this candidate because its border hierarchy did not
match approved concept #118. The runtime wrapped each interior bay in a dark,
double-line rim with a shadow, making the composition read as several boxed
modules. The concept instead uses a substantial walnut-and-brass outer
book-board chassis with quiet, thin parchment separators inside it.

These files are retained only as historical evidence. They are not an
acceptance baseline and must not be reused as current goldens.
